cards.front: ¿Crees que mi amiga Kylie y su marido se podrían hospedar en tu casa las dos próximas noches?
cards.back: Do you think you could put my friend Kylie and her husband up for the next two nights?

cards.front: Les ofrecimos a los Collier que se alojaran en casa cuando vinieran a la ciudad.
cards.back: We offered to put up the Colliers when they came to town.

cards.front: ¿Me puedo alojar en tu casa durante unos días mientras estoy en Oslo?
cards.back: Can you put me up for a few days while I'm in Oslo?

cards.front: Mi marido y yo dormimos en dormitorios diferentes porque no soporto sus ronquidos.
cards.back: My husband and I sleep in different bedrooms because I can't put up with his snoring.

cards.front: Le ofrecimos a Lisa que se alojara en casa una semana, pero no creo que pueda aguantarla tanto tiempo.
cards.back: We offered to put Lisa up for a week, but I don't think I'll be able to put up with her for that long!

cards.front: ¿Cómo soportas a una persona que está todo el día hablando a las espaldas de los demás?
cards.back: How can you put up with someone talking behind other people's backs all day?

cards.front: Alberto puso su apartamento en venta porque se había quedado demasiado pequeño para él y su novia.
cards.back: Alberto put his flat up for sale because it had become too small for him and his girlfriend.

cards.front: Raúl subastó su cuadro favorito porque necesitaba dinero para comprarle un anillo de boda a Alison.
cards.back: Raúl put his favourite painting up for auction because he needed money to buy Alison an engagement ring.

cards.front: Richard y Ana pusieron su casa en venta porque no soportaban el ruido que hacían sus vecinos.
cards.back: Richard and Ana put their house up for sale because they couldn't put up with all the noise that their neighbours made.

cards.front: Roula dio a su hijo en adopción en 1982.
cards.back: Roula put up her son for adoption in 1982.

cards.front: Si Megan se quedara embarazada, daría a su bebé en adopción porque no soporta a los niños.
cards.back: If Megan got pregnant, she would put the baby up for adoption because she can't put up with children.

cards.front: La hija de Marissa tenía solo una semana cuando la dieron en adopción.
cards.back: Marissa's daughter was only one week old when she was put up for adoption.

cards.front: No quería hacerlo, pero él me empujó a ello.
cards.back: I didn't want to do it, but he put me up to it.

cards.front: No culpes a David; fue idea de Peter: él me empujó a ello.
cards.back: Don't blame David, it was Peter's idea; he put me up to it.

cards.front: No estoy enfadado con tus amigos; ellos no te empujaron a ello.
cards.back: It's not your friends I'm angry with; they didn't put you up to it.

cards.front: Tuvieron que retrasar la reunión sobre enfermedades infecciosas emergentes.
cards.back: They had to put the meeting on emerging infectious diseases back.

cards.front: Puede que retrasemos la reunión para el 2 de junio.
cards.back: We might put the meeting back to the 2nd of June.

cards.front: Su jefe quiere que retrasemos cinco horas la reunión de hoy.
cards.back: His boss wants us to put today's meeting back five hours.

cards.front: El último domingo de octubre atrasamos los relojes a las dos y ganamos una hora extra.
cards.back: We put the clocks back at 2 a.m. on the last Sunday in October and we gain an extra hour.

cards.front: Atrasamos los relojes una hora.
cards.back: We put the clocks back one hour.

cards.front: No olvides atrasar los relojes una hora esta noche.
cards.back: Don't forget to put the clocks back an hour tonight.

cards.front: El último domingo de abril adelantamos los relojes a las dos y perdemos una hora de noche.
cards.back: We put the clocks forward at 2 a.m. on the last Sunday in April and we lose an hour during the night.

cards.front: Adelantamos los relojes para el horario de verano.
cards.back: We put the clocks forward for daylight saving time.

cards.front: Hay más luz por las tardes y menos por las mañanas cuando adelantamos los relojes.
cards.back: Afternoons have more daylight and mornings have less when we put the clocks forward.

cards.front: Él es muy travieso y nunca vuelve a poner nada en su sitio.
cards.back: He's very naughty and never puts anything back where it belongs.

cards.front: Asegúrate de volver a poner ese libro donde lo cogiste.
cards.back: Make sure you put that book back where you got it from.

cards.front: Después de hojear la revista la volví a poner en su sitio.
cards.back: After leafing through the magazine, I put it back where it was before.

cards.front: La ginecóloga dijo: «Puede vestirse ahora».
cards.back: The gynecologist said: "You can put your clothes back on now."

cards.front: Decidieron atrasar la reunión, así que volvimos a poner los contratos en nuestros maletines y nos fuimos.
cards.back: They decided to put the meeting back, so we put the contracts back into our briefcases and left.

cards.front: Me di cuenta de que algo goteaba, así que volví a poner el coche en el garaje.
cards.back: I realized something was leaking, so I put my car back in the garage.

cards.front: Sus padres le regañan cada vez que se niega a guardar los juguetes.
cards.back: His parents tell him off every time he refuses to put away his toys.

cards.front: ¿Qué te parece si tú guardas los platos y yo la ropa?
cards.back: How about you put the dishes away and I put the clothes away?

cards.front: ¿Cuántas veces tengo que decirle a mi marido que guarde las herramientas en el cobertizo?
cards.back: How many times do I have to tell my husband to put the tools away in the shed?

cards.front: Richard necesita guardar dinero para cuando lleguen las vacas flacas.
cards.back: Richard needs to put some money away for a rainy day.

cards.front: Alberto está ahorrando dinero para comprar un apartamento más grande.
cards.back: Alberto's putting some money away to buy a bigger flat.

cards.front: Alison ahorró dinero y se compró un descapotable.
cards.back: Alison put some money away and bought herself a convertible.

cards.front: Encerraron a Rob «el pirómano» durante diez años por quemar 10.000 hectáreas de bosque.
cards.back: Rob "the arsonist" was put away for ten years after burning 10,000 hectares of forest.

cards.front: Encerraron a James «el ladrón de tiendas» después de robar toda la ropa de El Corte Francés.
cards.back: James "the shoplifter" was put away after stealing all the clothes from El Corte Francés.

cards.front: Han encerrado a Stewart «el violador» para que siga un largo tratamiento.
cards.back: Stewart "the rapist" has been put away for long-term treatment.

cards.front: Nunca he visto a nadie engullir donuts de esa manera.
cards.back: I've never seen anyone put doughnuts away like that.

cards.front: Anita es capaz de zamparse una caja entera de bombones.
cards.back: Anita is capable of putting away a whole box of chocolates.

cards.front: Tenía tanta hambre que me zampé dos hamburguesas.
cards.back: I was so peckish I put two burgers away!

cards.front: Raúl ha estado ahorrando dinero para comprarle un anillo de boda a Alison.
cards.back: Raúl has been putting some money away to buy Alison an engagement ring.

cards.front: En lo que va de mes han encerrado a 459 delincuentes.
cards.back: So far this month, 459 criminals have been put away.

cards.front: Después de guardar sus herramientas, se zampó dos pizzas.
cards.back: After putting away his tools, he put two pizzas away!

cards.front: El técnico desmontó la caldera y no supo volver a montarla.
cards.back: The technician took the boiler apart and didn't know how to put it back together!

cards.front: Si desmontaras tu portátil, ¿sabrías volver a montarlo?
cards.back: If you took your laptop apart, would you know how to put it back together?

cards.front: Él usó el destornillador y la llave inglesa para desmontar la aspiradora y volver a montarla.
cards.back: He used the screwdriver and spanner to take the vacuum cleaner apart and put it back together.

cards.front: Cogí el bolígrafo y cuando terminé de escribir las 50 tarjetas de Navidad que tenía, lo solté.
cards.back: I picked up the pen and when I finished writing the 50 Christmas cards I had, I put it down.

cards.front: Es un libro tan interesante que cada vez que lo cojo no lo puedo dejar.
cards.back: It's such an interesting book that whenever I pick it up I can't put it down!

cards.front: El jugador cogió dos cartas de la baraja y dejó cinco en la mesa.
cards.back: The player picked two cards up from the deck and put five down on the table.

cards.front: Colgamos un cartel para que la gente supiera dónde era la fiesta y lo descolgamos cuando se acabó.
cards.back: We put a sign up to let everybody know where the party was and took it down when it was over.

cards.front: Los albañiles pusieron los andamios y los quitaron cuando se terminó el edificio.
cards.back: The builders put the scaffolding up and took it down when the building was finished.

cards.front: La próxima semana pondrán las luces en este pueblo y las quitarán cuando se terminen las fiestas.
cards.back: Next week they'll put the lights up in this village and take them down when the local holidays are over.

cards.front: Cuando Sally llegó a casa se quitó el uniforme del colegio y se puso el pijama.
cards.back: When Sally got home she took her school uniform off and put her pyjamas on.

cards.front: Después del trabajo Charles siempre se quita el traje y se pone el chándal.
cards.back: After work, Charles always takes his suit off and puts his tracksuit on.

cards.front: Fui al vestuario a quitarme la ropa y ponerme el bañador.
cards.back: I went to the changing room to take my clothes off and put my swimming costume on.

cards.front: Han subido sus precios para cubrir costes.
cards.back: They've put up their prices in order to cover costs.

cards.front: Es probable que las compañías aéreas suban los precios en un cinco por ciento.
cards.back: Airline companies are likely to put up prices by 5%.

cards.front: Los ingresos del turismo internacional descendieron el año pasado en el tercer trimestre.
cards.back: International tourism revenue went down during the third quarter last year.

cards.front: Jamás te lo juegues todo a una sola carta.
cards.back: Never put all your eggs in one basket.

cards.front: No me lo quise jugar todo a una carta, así que compré más de un décimo de lotería.
cards.back: I didn't want to put all my eggs in one basket, so I bought more than one lottery ticket.

cards.front: ¿Puedes permitirte jugártelo todo a una carta?
cards.back: Can you afford to put all your eggs in one basket?

cards.front: ¿No crees que estás empezando la casa por el tejado buscando un vestido de novia antes de que Mathew te pida que te cases con él?
cards.back: Aren't you putting the cart before the horse by looking for a wedding dress before Mathew has proposed to you?

cards.front: Hacer lo contrario sería empezar la casa por el tejado.
cards.back: Doing the opposite would be to put the cart before the horse.

cards.front: Hacer eso es, en lo que a mí respecta, empezar la casa por el tejado.
cards.back: Doing that is, as far as I'm concerned, to put the cart before the horse.

cards.front: Necesito algunas ideas para mi libro, así que sería fantástico si pudieras estrujarte el cerebro.
cards.back: I need some ideas for my book, so it would be great if you could put your thinking cap on.

cards.front: Todavía tengo muchas hojas que escribir, así que debería estrujarme las neuronas.
cards.back: I still have a lot of pages to write, so I should put my thinking cap on.

cards.front: Él debe estrujarse el cerebro si quiere impresionar a los inversores.
cards.back: He must put his thinking cap on if he wants to impress the investors.

cards.front: Hay algo que me resulta raro de mi vecino, pero no sabría decir exactamente qué es.
cards.back: There's something weird about my neighbour, but I can't quite put my finger on it.

cards.front: Sé que algo va mal, pero no sé decir exactamente qué es.
cards.back: I know there's something wrong, but I can't put my finger on exactly what it is.

cards.front: Estás diferente, pero no sé decir exactamente en qué.
cards.back: Something is different about you, but I can't put my finger on it.

cards.front: Después de que saliera cinco noches seguidas con sus compañeros de trabajo, su mujer decidió plantarse.
cards.back: After he went out five nights in a row with his workmates, his wife decided to put her foot down.

cards.front: Cuando mi hermana empezó a coger mi coche sin permiso, tuve que plantarme.
cards.back: When my sister started borrowing my car without asking, I had to put my foot down.

cards.front: No puedes dejar que tu hijo te conteste; tendrás que imponerte.
cards.back: You can't let your son answer back; you'll have to put your foot down.

cards.front: ¿Cómo lo diría? Tu idea fue la peor que he oído jamás.
cards.back: How can I put it? Your idea was the worst I've ever heard.

cards.front: ¿Cómo lo diría? ¡Estás despedido!
cards.back: How can I put this? You're sacked!

cards.front: ¿Cómo te diría? La casa fue derribada hace solo dos años.
cards.back: How can I put it? The house was knocked down only two years ago.

cards.front: Te diré lo siguiente: no les invitaremos a casa en el futuro inmediato.
cards.back: Let's put it this way: we won't be inviting them around in the foreseeable future.

cards.front: Te diré lo siguiente: no era precisamente Pavarotti.
cards.back: Let's put it this way: he was no Pavarotti.

cards.front: Te diré lo siguiente: tendrás noticias de mi abogado.
cards.back: Let me put it this way: you'll be hearing from my lawyer.

cards.front: Esa no fue la mejor película que he visto, por no decir algo peor.
cards.back: That wasn't the greatest film I've seen, to put it mildly.

cards.front: Estaba un poquitito enfadado, por no decir algo peor.
cards.back: I was a little bit miffed, to put it mildly.

cards.front: Estábamos un poco asustados, por no decir algo peor.
cards.back: We were all a little scared, to put it mildly.

cards.front: No te quiero, hablando en plata.
cards.back: I don't love you, to put it bluntly.

cards.front: Hablando claro, eres aburridísimo.
cards.back: To put it bluntly, you're really boring.

cards.front: Tu italiano es una porquería, hablando en plata.
cards.back: Your Italian sucks, to put it bluntly.

cards.front: Bueno, si lo dices así, ¿cómo puedo negarme?
cards.back: Well, if you put it like that, how can I say no?

cards.front: Bueno, si lo dices así, ya no parece tan importante.
cards.back: Well, if you put it like that, it doesn't seem quite so important.

cards.front: Bueno, si lo dices así, haré los deberes ahora mismo.
cards.back: Well, if you put it like that, I'll do my homework right away!
